## Manage every client interaction in one place

Emails, notes, and details for every client are located in one shared space. Easily track who last contacted a client, what was discussed, and when it occurred.

AI-powered summaries instantly update you on client activity, giving you full visibility to respond to client queries with confidence. Managing client relationships has never been easier.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What makes a CRM built for accounting firms different from traditional CRM software?

A CRM solution built specifically for accounting firms is designed to manage long-term client relationships, recurring services, client communication, and compliance needs. General-purpose CRMs are often built around sales pipelines and customer operations, while accounting firms also need recurring work, deadlines, client requests, and service delivery history in the same system.

The best CRM software for accounting firms integrates with practice management tools, task management, and client data. It handles complex client structures (e.g., households, trusts, businesses), supports unified contact records, and gives teams a shared view of client work. Key features include secure document management, automated workflows, client communication tools, and reporting on WIP, profitability, and service delivery.

Karbon connects relationship management, service delivery, invoicing, and payment collection around the way accounting firms work.

How does Karbon combine CRM, email, workflow, and payment tools into one platform for accountants?

Karbon is a cloud-based practice management solution built for accounting firms, combining CRM features, email, task management, invoicing, and payments in one platform.

Every client interaction is connected in real time to client records and workflows, improving visibility and keeping communication clear. Automated workflows with templates trigger tasks, email reminders, and follow-ups based on due dates or client activity.

Integrations with accounting software like Xero and QuickBooks keep contact and invoicing data up to date. Karbon helps your firm collaborate, organize client communication, and deliver a consistent client experience.

Can Karbon work with the CRM and contact tools I already use?

Yes. Karbon syncs companies and contacts from [HubSpot](https://karbonhq.com/integrations/hubspot/), so client details don't have to be entered twice. It also connects with Xero and QuickBooks to keep client and billing data current, and its open API can connect other systems.

This can reduce the need for a separate CRM, since Karbon includes CRM functionality tailored to accountants and keeps client work, communication, and records in one place.

How do I migrate from another CRM or practice management system to Karbon?

Migrating to Karbon is supported by Karbon's onboarding team, whether you're moving from a non-accounting CRM like Insightly, Salesforce, HubSpot CRM, or Zoho CRM, another practice management tool, or a patchwork of Excel spreadsheets.

The team helps map your current setup and migrate key client data, including contact details, work templates, job history, and team assignments.

CSV import tools, template builders, and integrations help you recreate workflows, automate client tasks, and organize communication history. You'll also have access to personalized training, customer support, and a [help library](https://help.karbonhq.com/) to guide your transition.

How does Karbon help accounting firms manage high volumes of client communication?

Karbon helps your firm manage high volumes of client communication by turning email into collaborative, workflow-connected threads linked to each client and job.

Karbon's deep email integration means every email can be assigned, commented on, turned into a task, or linked to work, giving your team clearer accountability and visibility. Features like shared inboxes, threaded email, email templates, and intelligent filtering help organize client communication and reduce inbox clutter.

Triage AI (coming soon) reads each email's context to auto-label priority, client queries, and meeting invites, and can draft a reply or route it to the right person. Real-time notifications, @mentions, a mobile app, and timeline views help your team respond to client needs and keep handoffs visible.

Can Karbon support complex, multi-step client workflows, like monthly bookkeeping or annual tax prep?

Yes, Karbon is designed for complex, recurring workflows like monthly bookkeeping, annual tax prep, payroll, and advisory services. Customizable templates let you build multi-step processes that combine tasks, automations, checklists, and scheduled client emails. Client requests and due dates map to each timeline. For monthly bookkeeping and CAS work, Karbon + Aider also automates period close checks, flags exceptions, and supports transaction coding so your team can close with less manual reconciliation.

Karbon also supports task dependencies, time-based triggers (e.g., "start 10 days before due"), and role-based assignments to coordinate work across your team. The result is a repeatable process that gives everyone clarity on what needs to be done, when, and by whom.

What automations does Karbon offer to help firms stay on top of client deadlines and follow-ups?

Karbon offers workflow automation to help your firm stay ahead of client deadlines and follow-ups. Work templates trigger tasks, client requests, due dates, and email reminders based on the rules you set.

Karbon can send client requests on a schedule and follow up on its own when one is incomplete. Submitted requests are flagged for the right person on your team, so communication stays on track. Combined with real-time alerts and email threading, Karbon helps automate repetitive tasks and deliver consistent, on-time service without micromanagement.

How does Karbon give partners and managers visibility into team capacity and client status?

Karbon gives you real-time visibility into team capacity and client work by centralizing tasks, timelines, client information, and communication in one platform.

[Work dashboards](https://karbonhq.com/resources/karbon-work-dashboards/) and Kanban boards show what each team member is working on, plus what's overdue or coming up.

You can filter by assignee, client, due date, and status. Capacity planning and forecasting tools highlight current and future workloads, helping you allocate resources and avoid bottlenecks.

AI-powered client record summaries, team activity feeds, and shared timelines give your team more context for handoffs and staff absences. Kai, Karbon's AI coworker (in early access), can deliver a daily briefing on what needs attention across the firm and answer questions about work status without digging through Karbon.

What kinds of client insights and reporting can Karbon's CRM surface for accounting firms?

Karbon's CRM brings client data, communication history, and work tracking into one shared record for your firm.

From each client record, you can see past and upcoming work, open tasks, communication threads, and internal notes. You get a clearer view of client status, including who's engaged and who's falling behind.

At the firm level, [Karbon Analytics](https://karbonhq.com/feature/analytics/)' pre-built dashboards, including one for Client Communication, reveal trends across work in progress, client responsiveness, service delivery consistency, staff capacity, and at-risk engagements.

You can filter, sort, and group work views by client, service, due date, or assignee, giving you visibility into both operational and relationship health.

AI-powered analytics also let you ask questions about firm performance in plain language and get instant insights without building the report by hand.

Can I track custom client data in Karbon?

Yes. You can add custom fields to client and contact records to track the data your firm cares about, like entity type, filing dates, or service tier.

You can then use Contact Segments to build saved views that filter and group clients by those fields, so you can act on a specific segment in one place.

Does Karbon use AI to help manage clients?

Yes. Karbon AI is currently available to all Karbon customers and works inside your client records. It creates a client summary that combines a client's communications, work, and billing data. Your team can review recent client context before every meeting.

It drafts and refines client emails in your firm's writing style, and Smart Suggestions help your team choose the right colleague or contact based on prior work.

Firms in limited early access can also use [Kai](https://karbonhq.com/feature/kai/), Karbon's AI coworker built to know your firm and work like part of the team, to ask about a client in plain language and get answers from live firm data.

Is Karbon suitable for both small firms and multi-office practices?

Yes. Karbon supports both small teams and large, multi-office accounting practices. For small firms, Karbon brings client work, contact management, communication, and collaboration into one place, reducing the need to manage those workflows across separate tools.

Automated workflows and shared visibility help smaller teams stay organized, responsive, and consistent. For larger or multi-location firms, Karbon offers team management, advanced work templates, capacity planning, and visibility across offices.

With customizable user permissions, team filters, and global reporting, partners and managers keep control and consistency while giving each office room to work independently. Whether you're a three-person firm or a 300-person operation, Karbon scales with you.

What security and compliance standards does Karbon meet to protect sensitive client data?

Karbon protects sensitive client data with documented security controls. This includes:

- SOC 2 Type 2 certification for Karbon's web application product
- An ISMS implemented in accordance with ISO 27001, though not yet independently certified
- Data and regular backups encrypted at rest with AES-256-bit encryption
- In-app user permissions that control what data a user can access and which firm-wide settings they can change
- A client portal that uses Transport Layer Security (TLS) to encrypt data in transit
- Karbon AI built on the Azure OpenAI Service, which includes enterprise security and compliance controls
- Privacy practices and internal assessments that support GDPR compliance

Is my client data secure when Karbon uses AI?

Yes. Karbon AI works within the roles and permissions your firm already sets, so people see only the clients and work they should. Your firm's data stays in Karbon.

It isn't shared externally or used to train AI models. [Karbon AI](https://karbonhq.com/feature/ai/) processes that data in [the region where it's stored](https://karbonhq.com/release-notes/mar-31-2026/). Karbon's web application product is SOC 2 Type 2 certified, with encryption in transit and at rest.
